notes: «قال سألت يحيى بن الجزار»: Musa is the asker and already a link; Yahya is the one asked and answers, so he is the last link. «قال قلت كم كان» is Musa again and «قال خمس الخمس» is Yahya's answer
«أبو إسحاق» is a bare kunya, written as the text gives it; «أنبأنا» and «قال» are transmission verbs
